snippet.title: Silent Road Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
~WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM~
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4124320/Silent_Road

Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.
